sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 730 numbered physical subjects / 710 family-card identities and 136 unnumbered artists are retained across 20 families. Original unlabelled text columns change meaning by family and are not reinterpreted as teams. Repeated 1 UP and Marquee Motion subjects remain separate. All 133 odds categories and five exact headings are preserved, including three 1:XX placeholders, the original dash plus 1:832 cell and Super Box Bonus Pack 5:1. No ratio unit is printed, so no pack rate is calculated. Only the base FoilFractor 1/1 is mapped. Guide five-copy Spider-Man and ten-copy Chrome Silver Surfer examples have no named parallel or serial marking. Calendar release and exhaustive numbering remain unverified.
Calendar release and any exhaustive serial-number ladder remain unverified; guide publication and debut year are separate facts.
Spider-Man five-copy and Silver Surfer ten-copy examples name no parallel or serial marking; neither becomes a family /5 or /10 limit.
Sketch artwork uniqueness does not number artist roster entries or establish their individual odds eligibility.
Three original odds cells print 1:XX. Preserve the placeholders without computing rates; the sheet names formats but no ratio unit.
The original MARVEL SNAP XL GOLD FOIL / SUPER BOX cell prints a dash above 1:832; both are retained without choosing a value.
